findings.description: verifyConstructionEvidence is called only inside the source loop of a parent unit PASS code-review criterion. With no such criterion, the actual aggregate verifier never performs child artifact, TAP or current-source IO verification, even when a child is marked Done.
findings.effect: Metadata-valid child completion can be rendered/ticked without verifying its referenced execution evidence. When the branch is entered, the same full child verification is redundantly repeated once per parent source.
findings.neededChange: Call the child evidence verifier unconditionally once in the aggregate verification function used by synchronize, outside all parent facet/source loops, and add aggregate-path tests with To Do parents/no unit PASS plus missing/tampered child artifacts and source drift.

actualNegativeReproduction.method: Read exact hash-pinned private aggregate function and expose it only in memory. All cards/state and missing-review references are in-memory negative fixtures; no production file or board is changed.
observations: Direct real child IO verifier rejects the nonexistent review artifact.
The same metadata-valid Done child with no parent unit PASS is accepted by the frozen aggregate function.
Actual aggregate child IO verifier calls: 0.
The intended fail-closed regression fails with Missing expected rejection.

preservedRulesReviewed: Canonical 78 parents, 52 children, 281 clauses, 491 facets and 13 gates are preserved by the baseline tests.
Construction-only allowlist, current author/reviewer identities, distinct other-role quorum and child prerequisite checks are present.
Native/hosted children and parent/native completion remain separate from construction metadata.
cleanup: No implementation edits, board/wiki/scopes edits, services, Maven or cloud operations. Original passing baseline and failing negative reproduction are retained in unique R3 outputs.
nextAction: Orchestrator confirmed the finding and owns the implementation fix/refreeze. A fresh exact aggregate integration rerun is required; the original 48 PASS is not acceptance.
